title: pilosella vulpina
intro: Pilosella vulpina, commonly known as Mouse Ear Hawkweed, is a perennial plant in the dandelion family that grows in acidic soils and is native to Europe and Asia. The plant is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella vulpina include its ability to stimulate the immune system, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, as well as flavonoids and phenolic acids that contribute to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
